name: quik-formstream-ui
description: FormStream UI — an embeddable Angular custom element (<quik-formstream>) for rendering and completing Quik! forms in any host page.

scripts.build: ng build formstream-element --configuration development && node bundle.js
scripts.build-prod: ng build formstream-element --configuration production && node bundle.js
scripts.build-local: ng build formstream-element --configuration local && node bundle.js
scripts.version: npm run build-prod && git add dist/formstream/formstream-bundle.js
scripts.watch: concurrently --names "ELEMENT,BUNDLE" --prefix-colors "green,magenta" "ng build formstream-element --configuration local --watch --delete-output-path=false" "nodemon --watch dist/formstream/main.js --watch dist/formstream/styles.css --delay 2 --exec \"node bundle.js --lenient\""
